title: ケープ・ジョーンズ・ダンス (Cape Jones Dance)
kind: anime-intro song for the Cape Jones dance scene
built_from: Tamagotchi loop (music-pullin proof-track) extended to full song; FluidR3_GM + FluidSynth render chain
master_chain: repo pedalboard_master.py (HP30 -> comp -18dB 2:1 10/120ms -> limiter) then loudnorm verify/trim to -14 LUFS, TP -1.0
vocal_chain: digital_fairy_chain Avanna bus (HPF150, presence +3@3k, comp 3:1, limiter -1) -> build_vocal_mix_v19 ffmpeg stack (mud -5@300, +6@3k/5k/8k, shelf +4@12k, deesser, comp 4:1) + bit-crush parallel (acrusher 10-bit mix .2) + slapback/echo wet; layers: harmony x0.5 (human bus), octave HP250+chorus x0.35 (chorus B + outro)

vocal_production_honest_note: Sung by a Japanese guide voice (espeak-ng ja+f5, ~345 Hz) transformed with the Mochiichao repo's own v19 rubberband method: per-note Rubber Band pitch placement on the written melody (hard autotune by construction) + decoupled formant lift x1.7. Avanna is an English Vocaloid voicebank; VOCALOID5 cannot run on this Linux box and no voicebank/installer/project files exist in either repo (verified by full-tree search). The real Avanna/VOCALOID5 assets wait for the owner's Windows/Mac seat; the stack + method now live in production/vocal-stack/.

v2_remix.owner_complaint: as soon as the lyrics vocals drop then the beat is almost unhearable

measured_v1_problem.mechanism: the over-hot vocal bus ate the shared master compressor/limiter budget, so the beat was pumped down exactly when the vocal entered; the tinkle-bell sparkle also sits 99% inside the vocal's 2-5 kHz presence band

architecture: per-section vocal gains solved to LUFS targets (verses +1.0, choruses +0.5, bridge +1.5, outro +1.5)
static carve -2 dB @ 3 kHz on square lead + arp; sparkle trimmed 0.8 -> 0.7
TrackSpacer-style spectral ducking (custom STFT, Mid channel only): vocal key dips only clashing bins of arp/lead/sparkle, max ~4 dB, fast attack / ~150 ms release; drums+bass never ducked
stereo: vocal lead centre-focused (Haas 0.30 -> 0.18), arp widened +2 dB side
instrumental section gains: intro 0, verses -0.5, choruses 0, bridge -2, outro -1 dB
master unchanged: pedalboard_master house chain + loudnorm to the locked -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP spine
v2_remix.english_vocal_note: Sung with the same repo v19 method as the JP take: espeak-ng en+f5 guide voice, one syllable at a time, Rubber Band pitch placement on the same written melody, formant lift x1.7, then the same Digital Fairy Avanna bus + v19 layers. English lines were syllable-adapted to the JP note grid (counts asserted in build_vocal_en.py). Avanna herself still cannot sing here (English Vocaloid voicebank; editor lives on the owner's Windows/Mac seat).
